title: Skills in Demand visa (subclass 482) - change in situation

sections.heading: Changing the worker's employer
sections.text: A visa holder cannot start working for a different employer until that employer has a new approved nomination.

sections.heading: Changing the worker's hours
sections.text:
If you employ a visa holder in the Core Skills Stream, their earnings must continue to meet the Core Skills Income Threshold (CSIT).

Earnings for Specialist Skills Stream visa holders must continue to meet the Specialist Skills income Threshold (SSIT).

Unless working in an exempt occupation or limited circumstances apply, SID visa holders must be employed on a full-time basis.

sections.heading: Changing the worker's duties
sections.text: You must submit a new nomination if you change the worker's role to a new role with new duties. The employee will also need to apply for and be granted a new visa.

sections.heading: Changing the worker's location
sections.text:
What kind of location changes you could make depends on what visa the worker holds.

Some visas require the visa holder to work in a specific location.

sections.heading: Promoting the worker
sections.text:
You can promote the sponsored worker as long as their duties don't change.

You must submit a new nomination to promote the worker to a new role with new duties. The employee will also need to apply for and be granted a new visa.

sections.heading: Paying the worker more
sections.text:
You can pay a worker more as long as their duties don't change.

If you employ a visa holder in the Core Skills Stream, their earnings must continue to meet the Core Skills Income Threshold (CSIT).

Earnings for Specialist Skills Stream visa holders must continue to meet the Specialist Skills income Threshold (SSIT).

You must make a new nomination to employ the worker in a new role with new duties.

sections.heading: Stop employing or sponsoring a worker
sections.text:
If you stop employing or sponsoring an employee or they resign you must let us know within 28 days.

- complete the new Notification of sponsor changes form in ImmiAccount
- Send an email to sponsor.notifications@abf.gov.au

The employee has up to 180 days from the date they finish working with you to:

- find another approved sponsor to nominate them,
- be granted a different visa, or
- leave Australia

Until then you must meet your sponsor obligations to the visa holder and their dependents.

You are responsible for paying reasonable and necessary travel costs for the visa holder and their dependents to leave Australia.

If the visa holder or any of their dependents becomes unlawful, you might have to pay the cost of locating them and removing them from Australia.

sections.heading: Taking over a sponsorship
sections.text:
If you wish to take over the sponsorship of someone who is sponsored by another employer or under a labour agreement, you must:

- be an approved sponsor for the visa held by them
- lodge a nomination.

The visa holder does not need to submit a new visa application unless their visa is about to expire. However, if the visa holder is moving from a Labour Agreement to a Standard Business Sponsor employer, a new visa application will need to be lodged.

If the visa holder is changing duties, a new visa will need to be lodged in the new occupation.

sections.heading: If the worker's visa is expiring
sections.text:
If the worker's visa is expiring and you want to keep employing them:

- you must make a new nomination
- they must apply for a new visa

They can't stay longer by extending the visa.

sections.heading: Changing from a temporary to a permanent visa
sections.text: If your employee holds a Skills in Demand visa, you may be able to sponsor them for permanent residence through the Employer Nomination Scheme (subclass 186).

sections.heading: Employing more people from overseas
sections.text: You can nominate more people if you want to employ more workers from overseas.

sections.heading: Reporting an employee for breach of visa conditions
sections.text:
Let us know if the worker breaches their visa conditions.

- complete the new Notification of sponsor changes form in ImmiAccount

- for a step-by-step guide, see Notifying the Department when an Employee Has Ceased Employment

- Send an email to sponsor.notifications@abf.gov.au
